Damage taken -180; If equipped by an [Ægir] Operator, that Operator's <@ba.vup>Devour</> range increases to 4 adjacent tiles, and adds on [Ægir] stacks accordingly
<@ba.acrem>If 'Ægirian Blade' is also equipped by the [Ægir] Operator, the Operator gains extra HP equal to the HP of the <@ba.vup>Devoured</> allies</>
